title: OMRON Sysmac
summary: OMRON's NX and NJ machine automation controllers are programmed in Sysmac Studio and use EtherCAT for I/O and motion.

sections.heading: Platforms
sections.body: NX1P/NX102 compact controllers and NJ controllers; NX I/O units are connected locally or through EtherCAT couplers.

sections.heading: Conventions worth knowing
sections.body: Variables are mapped to I/O ports of NX units; programming follows IEC 61131-3.

sections.heading: In PLC Lab
sections.body: The `omron.nx-nj` knowledge profile presents the generic rack's channels as unit ports such as `Unit2_Ch1_In`. Sysmac Studio projects, EtherCAT and motion control are not modeled. **CONCEPTUAL**.
